title: FastSLM: Hierarchical Temporal Abstraction for Efficient Long-Form Speech Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2601.06199v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Scaling Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to long-form speech is bottlenecked by the explosive growth of input tokens. Existing speech-language models project high-frame-rate acoustic features directly into the LLM input space, making long-context processing computationally prohibitive. Unlike images or videos, speech lacks spatial redundancy, making extreme token compression particularly challenging. To address this limitation, we propose FastSLM, a token-efficient architecture featuring the Hierarchical Temporal Abstractor (HTA), which progressively distills acoustic features across multiple temporal scales. translated_title: FastSLM：面向高效长语音适应的分层时间抽象
translated_abstract: 将多模态大语言模型（MLLM）扩展到长音频场景一直受到输入token数量爆炸式增长的瓶颈制约。现有的语音-语言模型将高帧率的声学特征直接投影到LLM的输入空间，使得长上下文处理的计算成本令人望而却步。与图像或视频不同，语音缺乏空间冗余性，这使得极致的token压缩尤其具有挑战性。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了FastSLM，这是一种token高效的架构，其核心是分层时间抽象器（HTA），它可以在多个时间尺度上逐步提炼声学特征。HTA实现了每秒仅1.67个token的极致压缩率（压缩97%），同时保留了下游语音-语言理解所需的关键语言信息。实验结果表明，FastSLM在多样化的语音-语言任务中取得了具有竞争力的性能，同时所需的token数量大幅减少。
tldr: FastSLM通过分层时间抽象器（HTA）将语音特征压缩至每秒仅1.67个token（压缩率高达97%），在大幅降低长语音处理的计算成本的同时，保持了跨多种语音-语言任务的竞争力。
en_tdlr: FastSLM introduces a Hierarchical Temporal Abstractor (HTA) that compresses speech features to only 1.67 tokens per second (a 97% reduction), enabling efficient long-form speech adaptation with substantially lower computational cost while maintaining competitive performance across diverse speech-language tasks.
